scope: Partial F07 implementation/runtime evidence for the embedded Node device runtime only. One source fan-out reaches its 32-subscriber ceiling; 20,000 latest publications retain one slot per route and add no sustained heap growth above the 8 MiB guard; invalid payloads are rejected; 1,000 reliable events saturate a 64-operation queue and revocation cancels accepted work; four hanging providers consume the configured pending-delivery ceiling, abort on loss, and release admission only after settlement. This does not qualify WebRTC/native queues, supported capacity tiers, physical targets or a release workload. F07 remains open.
environment: macOS 26.5.2 arm64; Node 24.14.0 with --expose-gc; embedded runtime source imported locally; no network or device
